description: Expected output of the EDGAR 10-event feasibility pilot retrieval+scoring run. A future runner fills this in; they may not change the events, the rule, or the schema.

announcement_datetime.description: Explicit date + time-of-day from the 8-K and/or Exhibit 99.1, ISO 8601 with offset. Null if not explicit.

announcement_tz_evidence.description: Quotable evidence for the timezone, from the source itself (dateline, 'ET' stamp, wire header).

bucket.description: BTO (before open) / DTM (during session → EXCLUDE) / AMC (after close) / EXCLUDE (at close) / null if unscorable. Classified against that day's actual NYSE open/close per Amendment 1 section 1.

datetime_source_quote.description: Verbatim quote of the explicit datetime as it appears in the source.

fiscal_identity.description: Accounting identity of the event, read from the selected filing/exhibit (e.g. 'FY2019 Q3, quarter ended 2019-09-30').

sec_accepted_datetime_utc.description: SEC accepted datetime from the filing index. METADATA ONLY — never the announcement clock.

score.description: CLEAN or UNVERIFIABLE per the frozen scoring rule. No other values.

exhibit_99_1_filename.description: Filename of the press-release exhibit from the filing index. Null if absent.

no_filing.description: True only when no Item 2.02 8-K exists in the window. Then score must be UNVERIFIABLE.

package_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the sealed package manifest (MANIFEST.sha256) the runner used.

feasibility_rate.description: clean / scorable, or UNDETERMINED if scorable < 10 due to access failure.

title: EDGAR 10-event feasibility pilot — output schema
